form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. McCormick (for himself and Ms. Duckworth) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance

form.official-title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to modify rules relating to certain exempt facility bonds.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Transit for Urban Renewal and Business Opportunities Act or the TURBO Act.

section.header: Increase in national limitation for qualified highway or surface freight transfer facilities

subsection.text: Section 142(m)(2)(A) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by striking $30,000,000,000 and inserting $45,000,000,000.
The amendment made by this section shall apply to bonds issued after the date of the enactment of this Act.

section.header: Treatment of rolling stock related to mass commuting facilities

subsection.text: Section 142(a)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by inserting including the acquisition of rolling stock, after mass commuting facilities.
The amendment made by this section shall apply to bonds issued after the date of the enactment of this Act.

section.header: Modification of speed limit for high-speed intercity rail facilities

subsection.text: Section 142(i)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by striking 150 miles per hour and inserting 110 miles per hour.
The amendment made by this section shall apply to bonds issued after the date of the enactment of this Act.
